notes.n0.power: Utilities/IPPs with nuclear fleets (Constellation, Vistra, Talen) dominate near-term supply; SMR and fusion startups sell long-dated offtakes (Meta signed up to 6.6 GW of nuclear deals with Vistra, Oklo and TerraPower in Jan 2026); gas turbines are supply-constrained.
notes.n0.dcdev: Hyperscale development is financed by infra/PE and sovereign capital (Aligned sold for $40B to AIP/MGX/GIP in 2026); ex-bitcoin miners and neoclouds (Crusoe, Core Scientific, IREN) are a fast-growing AI-only tier; India adds new GW-scale entrants (TCS HyperVault, Reliance Jamnagar, AdaniConneX-Google Vizag).
notes.n0.grid: Concentrated among Schneider, Eaton, Vertiv, ABB, Siemens and GE Vernova; transformers and gas turbines have multi-year lead times, opening room for Korean transformer makers.
notes.n0.cooling: Rapid consolidation in 2025-26: Schneider-Motivair, Eaton-Boyd ($9.5B), Trane-LiquidStack, Ecolab-CoolIT ($4.75B); remaining independents are mostly two-phase/immersion startups.
notes.n0.build: US general contractors (Turner, DPR, Holder) and electrical/mechanical specialists capture most spend; prefab power/cooling modules from Vertiv and Schneider shorten builds.
notes.n0.capital: Private infra, PE and Gulf sovereign capital (MGX, PIF) fund most campuses; SoftBank took DigitalBridge private (Sep 2026).
notes.n0.opt: Early-stage; grid-flexibility software (Emerald AI, $150M raise in 2026) is the newest category, alongside AI-driven cooling control and digital twins.
notes.n0.ops: DCIM is mature and fragmented; incumbents are electrical/HVAC majors' software arms plus specialist vendors and FM outsourcers.
notes.n0.water: Fragmented treatment market led by Ecolab, Veolia and Xylem; water rights increasingly gate permits
notes.n0.storage: Bridge power is mostly gas (gensets, turbines, fuel cells) with batteries smoothing AI load swings
notes.n0.fuel: Gas pipelines feed behind-the-meter plants; HALEU supply (Centrus) gates advanced SMR fuel
notes.n0.land: Powered-land developers (Cloverleaf, Tract) pre-secure grid interconnects before selling to builders
